message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function for live currency conversion, so I’ll give you an approximate figure based on recent exchange rates.

As of the latest data I’ve seen (mid‑2024), the U.S. dollar to British pound rate is roughly **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP**. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So $20 is about **£15.60**.  

Keep in mind that exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so the exact amount you receive may differ slightly depending on when you check or which financial institution you use. If you need a precise, up‑to‑date conversion, you might want to consult a currency‑conversion API or your bank’s website.
